I believe that if this case were to come before a court today, in light of the new sensitivity toward

child exploitation, the case would have been cited in favor of Brooke Shields. Eventually the case was settled and the calendar wasn't distributed to Brooke's Princeton classmates. Brooke Shields went on to a successful career as a multi-dimensional performer.
